r1.name: Kado #1: Kamar Masa Kecil (Bedroom Sunrise)
r1.caption: The scene is a whimsical child's bedroom, rendered in a painted diorama style with soft, hand-painted textures, evoking a Saturday-morning cartoon aesthetic. The overall tone is playful and nostalgic, capturing the magic of a child's imagination. The room is designed with chunky, rounded shapes, and a gentle morning light filters through the curtains. A massive blanket fort dominates one section of the room, its fabric draped and folded to create an inviting hideaway. Oversized building blocks, in vibrant primary colors, are scattered around the perimeter, some stacked precariously, others forming small structures. A plush teddy bear, larger than life, sits comfortably amidst the blocks, its soft fur texture evident. An old CRT television glows with the colorful static of cartoons, its screen casting a soft, flickering light. The morning sun streams through sheer curtains, creating warm, diffused light across the scene. The center of the room remains an open, empty circular clearing, providing a sense of vastness from a toy's perspective. All the described scenery is arranged around the edges and in the distance, emphasizing the immense scale of the room. The blanket fort is positioned to the left, with the building blocks extending from its base towards the right. The plush teddy bear is nestled among the blocks, and the CRT TV is further to the right, its light a focal point. The curtains are visible along the far wall, allowing the morning light to penetrate the space. The 360 scene is faultless.

r2.name: Kado #2: Kota Mainan (Toy Block City)
r2.caption: The scene is a vibrant, whimsical city constructed entirely from colorful toy building blocks, rendered in a Saturday-morning cartoon style with soft, hand-painted textures. The overall tone is playful and imaginative, evoking a sense of childhood wonder. The city sprawls around an open, empty circular clearing at its center, with all the scenery concentrated around the edges and in the distance. Towering block skyscrapers, constructed from primary-colored blocks, define the skyline, their chunky, rounded shapes contributing to the toy-like aesthetic. A toy train bridge, also made of blocks, arches gracefully across a section of the city, connecting different areas. Block roads crisscross the landscape, populated by an assortment of toy cars, each with simple, rounded forms. Puffy cloud props, mounted on thin sticks, are strategically placed throughout the scene, adding to the diorama's charm. The entire city is bathed in bright daylight, casting gentle, even light across the scene. The block skyscrapers are arranged in clusters, forming distinct neighborhoods around the central clearing. The toy train bridge spans a gap between two of these block formations, with the block roads winding beneath and around it. The toy cars are scattered along the block roads, appearing to be in motion. The cloud props are positioned at varying heights, creating a sense of depth above the block structures. The 360 scene is faultless.

r3.name: Kado #3: Layangan Sore (Backyard Kite Season)
r3.caption: The scene is a vibrant, sunny suburban backyard, rendered in a charming Saturday-morning cartoon style with soft, hand-painted textures and chunky, rounded shapes, evoking the playful aesthetic of a cartoon toy set. The overall tone is joyful and whimsical, capturing the essence of a perfect late afternoon during kite season. The sky above is a delightful blend of orange and green hues, indicating the late afternoon light, and is dotted with numerous colorful kites, each with distinct shapes and patterns, soaring gracefully. A white picket fence, with its characteristic evenly spaced vertical slats and rounded tops, delineates the perimeter of the yard. A lush green tree, with a sturdy branch extending outward, supports a classic tire swing, its dark rubber contrasting with the bright foliage. A garden hose, coiled near the fence, is actively spraying sparkly arcs of water, catching the sunlight and creating miniature rainbows. The ground is covered in soft, green grass, meticulously manicured and free of debris. The center of the backyard remains an open, empty circular clearing, providing a sense of spaciousness and inviting imaginative play. All the described scenery, including the fence, tree, and garden hose, is positioned around the edges of this clearing and extends into the distance, creating a panoramic view. The colorful kites are scattered across the orange-green sky, some appearing closer and more detailed, while others are smaller and further away. The picket fence runs along the back of the yard, forming a gentle curve. The tree with the tire swing stands prominently to one side of the clearing, its branches reaching towards the sky. The garden hose is situated near the fence, its sparkling water arcs extending into the air. The 360 scene is faultless.

r4.name: Kado #4: Pasar Malam (Indonesian Night Market)
r4.caption: The scene is an Indonesian pasar malam night market, rendered in a charming painted diorama style, reminiscent of a Saturday-morning cartoon with soft, hand-painted textures and chunky, rounded shapes. The overall tone is festive and warm, evoking a sense of nostalgic joy. The center of the market features an open, empty circular clearing, providing a spacious area for imaginary activity. Around the edges of this clearing, a vibrant array of attractions and stalls creates a lively perimeter. A glowing carousel, adorned with whimsical animals and intricate details, stands prominently, its gentle lights casting a soft radiance. Strings of warm light bulbs crisscross overhead, illuminating the entire market with a cozy glow. Numerous wooden gerobak food carts, each featuring traditional designs and illuminated by charming lanterns, are strategically placed, offering a variety of imaginary culinary delights. A small Ferris wheel, with its chunky, rounded gondolas, rises into the distance, adding to the festive atmosphere. All scenery is carefully arranged around the edges and in the distance, ensuring the central clearing remains open and inviting. The 360 scene is faultless.

r5.name: Kado #5: Atap Penuh Bintang (Rooftop Under Stars)
r5.caption: The scene is a whimsical rooftop at night, rendered in a charming Saturday-morning cartoon style with soft, hand-painted textures and chunky, rounded shapes. The overall tone is magical and serene, evoking a sense of childlike wonder. The rooftop features an open, empty circular clearing at its center, allowing for an unobstructed view of the enchanting surroundings. Along the edges of the rooftop, a railing is adorned with numerous twinkling fairy lights, casting a gentle glow. Far below, the distant city lights sparkle like scattered jewels, creating a vibrant contrast with the dark expanse of the night sky. Above, a vast canvas of stars blankets the heavens, accompanied by a large, luminous moon that bathes the scene in a soft, ethereal light. In the distance, a single, oversized glowing gift box, meticulously wrapped with a prominent ribbon, stands out against the cityscape, hinting at a delightful surprise. The fairy lights on the railing encircle the central clearing, providing a warm, inviting border. The distant city lights stretch horizontally across the horizon, beneath the starry sky. The large moon is positioned high above the distant city, illuminating the gift box. The 360 scene is faultless.
